New fixture type based on F400Z from PRstage

PRstage F400Z is a professional LED spotlight with a high color rendering index of RA>95, delivering natural and vibrant colors on any stage. It supports two control modes — 11 and 13 CH, making it a versatile solution for various applications. Key features include: Lamp reset via menu or console, Smooth 0–100% dimming, Constant current drive for stable operation, Intelligent power adjustment based on temperature sensor, Automatic fan speed control. PRstage F400Z is perfect for concerts, bars, and theater stages where not only power but flawless color reproduction is essential.
